evals.name: scope-subject-erasure
evals.prompt: Forget one parcel recipient while retaining operational history for another. Design a disposable compliance check.
evals.expected_output: Isolated subjects with an authorized erasure check.
assertions: Uses synthetic data, opaque source IDs and explicit subject ownership.
Verifies the first value before erasure and its absence afterwards.
Verifies the control subject remains readable.

evals.name: remove-email-from-key
evals.prompt: Can we place email in the source ID because the payload email field has PII?
evals.expected_output: Refuses to expose personal data in unprotected metadata.
assertions: Recommends a stable surrogate ID independent of the email.
Rejects personal data in source IDs and tags.
Keeps diagnostic evidence free of plaintext.

evals.name: account-for-exported-copies
evals.prompt: After deleting a subject key, are CSV exports and every other copy gone?
evals.expected_output: Limits the erasure claim to the key's scope.
assertions: Does not recommend testing erasure with production credentials.
Distinguishes retained event position from readable protected value.
Names separate cleanup for exports and derived plaintext.
